title: Bug 641331: Copy Production Order Document lookup shows the current document
summary: The Copy Production Order Document report now excludes the current production order from the document lookup when searching for a source document, preventing a late error when the same order is selected.
key_points: Document lookup in LookupDocNo() now filters out the target production order
Filter only applies when the source status matches the target status
Prevents users from selecting the same document as the source, avoiding late-stage error
Aligns behavior with Copy Sales/Purchase Document reports
